title: רב יוסף ברי' דרב מנשי' מדויל

paragraphs: Rav Yosef son of Rav Menashya of Dovil—a place-name—was Rav’s student; see Yose bar Menashya. He sent to Shmuel: ‘Let our master teach us,’ Gittin 81a [printed chapter label: Mi SheAchazo]. Shmuel, Rav’s students, and Rav Yehudah were sitting; Rav Yosef bar Menashya passed: Niddah 26b. He acted according to Rav. Shmuel was angry and said: ‘For everyone else they measure with a small kav, and for this scholar they measure with a large kav’: Kiddushin 79b. After his death his wife came before Rav Yosef: Af Al Pi 65a.
